name: finance-toolkit
description: Personal finance skill suite for a mid-20s dual-income couple in Ho Chi Minh City. Covers budgeting, emergency fund building, investments, insurance, tax optimization, goal planning, and couple dynamics — all calibrated to Vietnam's financial ecosystem. Use when the user asks about budgeting, saving, investing, insurance, taxes, or financial goal planning — trigger phrases include "review our budget", "how should we invest", "do we have enough insurance", and "plan for a home purchase". Use even if the user only mentions one financial topic without asking for a full review.
